# Two queues and one borrowed kettle

People at the workshop wait for repairs and then wait again to pay for parts. We were timing only the work at the bench. The waiting time matters most to the parent who has to collect a child. Try taking payment at intake for predictable consumables, while making refunds easy. [[Repair ideas]] should include the route around the repair, not just the repair itself.
